$description: Mizzey design tokens, built from the client brand identity received 17 November 2026 (OD-01): logo Option 01, Royal Indigo, Persimmon, Cream, Mizzey Ink, Inter and Tajawal. Owner rulings of 18 November 2026: D-34. Values follow the closed Stage 2 design, Concept 1 at version 1795564351-dde6 (D-36): C1-System and its workspace tokens, the board winning where they differ. Values follow the closed Stage 2 design, Concept 1 at version 1795564351-dde6 (D-36): C1-System and its workspace tokens, the board winning where they differ. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG). status brand = a value from the brand pack; decided = an owner decision (DECISIONS.md), including the closed design (D-36); derived = computed from a brand value; carried = the structural value already used by the frozen low-fidelity wireframes; proposed = a starting value to confirm or change. A typography or dimension token may carry $extensions.mizzey.fluid: [at 390, at 1440] in rem, written as a clamp() between the two widths.
